description: Header file defining the class 'data_flow_cplane_metrics_decorator', which decorates data flow commands with metrics collection for the Open Fronthaul Control-Plane scheduling and beamforming commands.

classes.name: data_flow_cplane_metrics_decorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds metrics collection to data flow commands related to the Open Fronthaul Control-Plane scheduling and beamforming.

methods.name: get_operation_controller
methods.description: Returns a reference to the operation controller.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_1_message
methods.description: Enqueues a type 1 message and measures resource usage and latency.

methods.name: enqueue_section_type_3_prach_message
methods.description: Enqueues a type 3 PRACH message and measures resource usage and latency.

methods.name: get_metrics_collector
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the metrics collector interface.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects and reports metrics such as latency and CPU usage.
